question: Which seven are named in the guru-row rite?
premises: Named deities include Ganapati guru Parama
Paramesthi and prior-siddha speech-field-lord are named
Seven are named for guru-row worship
inference: The verse lists seven guru-row deities
plain_english: Ganapati, guru, Parama, Paramesthi, and the prior-siddha speech-field-lord, thus seven are named in the guru-row rite to be fully worshipped by our gurus.
